title: Refute: find signals, try to kill them, keep what survives
description:
Refute is an open-source framework where agents try to break scientific claims before anyone believes them. Claims are pre-registered and locked with SHA-256 hashes, attacked by deterministic falsification tests and a blind holdout, and reported in reproducible evidence dossiers. Agents propose; deterministic tests decide. A claim is never proven: it only survives, or it does not.

Version 0.4.0 closes v0.4 Discover, a pilot of complete, auditable cases for refute discover on TESS data (method_status: not_validated). Its five stage-2 dossiers are in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898648 and its reproduction inputs in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23874043. Refute produces candidates and verdicts only; nothing here is a confirmed discovery.
notes: The license field names the license of the code (Apache-2.0). It does not cover the third-party data files in the repository: each keeps its own terms, stated with their sources in calibration/v0.2/eb_snapshot/DATA_LICENSE.md and calibration/v0.4/DATA_LICENSE.md of this release (https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.4.0/calibration/v0.2/eb_snapshot/DATA_LICENSE.md and https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.4.0/calibration/v0.4/DATA_LICENSE.md). No single license covers the archive as a whole.
